data.narrative:
Applied Intuition, a Series F AI & Software company founded by Qasar Younis and Peter Ludwig, has raised $600M+ to date. The valuation universe spans 1 public comp (Palantir) and 8 private peers including Waymo, Figure AI, and Scale AI. The immediate peer set for stage-matched analysis includes Together AI (Series G, $8.3B), SandboxAQ (Series E, $5.8B), and Ayar Labs (Series E, $3.8B).

Only the peer-median method proved applicable to this analysis. Stage-progression analysis was excluded because the reported $15B post-money valuation implies a ratio of 25x total capital raised—a threshold that exceeds credibility bounds and likely reflects a funding-tracker data error. Peer-median triangulation across the three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yielded a median valuation of $5.8B, with a range spanning $3.8B to $8.3B.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $4.9B (low) to $6.6B (high), centered on $5.8B. This range reflects meaningful dispersion among peer stage and maturity profiles. Primary uncertainties include the reliability of the reported $15B entry valuation and the limited visibility into Applied Intuition's revenue run-rate relative to the peer set. A single triangulation method constrains confidence; additional data on revenue multiples or customer concentration would refine this estimate.
